type Component1Props = {
  className?: string;
  variant?: "2" | "13" | "14" | "15" | "16" | "17" | "18" | "19" | "20";
};

function Component1({ className, variant = "2" }: Component1Props) {
  const is13 = variant === "13";
  const is14 = variant === "14";
  const is16 = variant === "16";
  const is17 = variant === "17";
  const is19 = variant === "19";
  const is20 = variant === "20";
  return (
    <div className={className || `relative ${is20 ? String.raw`opacity-[calc(var(--opacity\/100,100)/100)] size-[16px]` : ["18", "19"].includes(variant) ? String.raw`opacity-[calc(var(--opacity\/100,100)/100)] overflow-clip size-[16px]` : is17 ? String.raw`h-[16.5px] opacity-[calc(var(--opacity\/100,100)/100)] w-[24px]` : ["15", "16"].includes(variant) ? String.raw`opacity-[calc(var(--opacity\/100,100)/100)] overflow-clip size-[24px]` : ["13", "14"].includes(variant) ? "h-[15px] w-[24px]" : "size-[20px]"}`} id={is20 ? "node-7838_21213" : is19 ? "node-7838_21210" : variant === "18" ? "node-7838_21200" : is17 ? "node-7838_21198" : is16 ? "node-7838_21195" : variant === "15" ? "node-7838_21188" : is14 ? "node-7838_21179" : is13 ? "node-7838_21176" : "node-7838_21073"}>
      {["2", "13", "14", "17", "20"].includes(variant) && <img alt="" className="absolute block inset-0 max-w-none size-full" src={is20 ? imgVariant20 : is17 ? imgVariant17 : is14 ? imgVariant14 : is13 ? imgVariant13 : imgVariant2} />}
      {["15", "16", "19"].includes(variant) && (
        <div className="absolute contents inset-[0_2.95%_0_0]" id={is19 ? "node-7838_21209" : is16 ? "node-7838_21194" : "node-7838_21187"} data-name="Clip path group">
          <div className={`${String.raw`absolute mask-alpha mask-intersect mask-no-clip mask-no-repeat opacity-[calc(var(--opacity\/100,100)/100)] `}${is19 ? "inset-[14.84%_2.95%_14.84%_0] mask-position-[0px_-2.375px] mask-size-[15.528px_16px]" : "inset-[0_2.95%_0_0] mask-size-[23.292px_24px]"}`} id={is19 ? "node-7838_21202" : is16 ? "node-7838_21190" : "node-7838_21181"} style={is19 ? { maskImage: `url("${imgGroup3}")` } : { maskImage: `url("${imgGroup}")` }} data-name="Group">
            <img alt="" className="absolute block inset-0 max-w-none size-full" src={is19 ? imgGroup4 : is16 ? imgGroup2 : imgGroup1} />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
